meta.title: Muscle Keeper — protect your muscle during GLP-1 treatment
meta.description: Estimate your risk of losing muscle during treatment with Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro and other GLP-1 medications, plus a suggested daily protein target.

hero.eyebrow: For people using Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro or other GLP-1 treatments
hero.title: You’re losing weight. The question is how much muscle you’re preserving.
hero.subtitle: Some of the weight lost during GLP-1 treatment may come from lean mass, not just fat. Answer 12 questions and get a personalised risk estimate.

problem.title: The muscle you lose doesn't come back on its own
problem.body: GLP-1 treatments can produce substantial weight loss. But total weight does not tell you how much came from fat and how much from lean mass. Without enough protein and muscle stimulus, you may reach a lower number on the scale without preserving all the muscle you need.

howItWorks.title: How it works
steps: Answer 12 questions about your treatment, progress, diet and current training.
We estimate your risk of muscle loss and a suggested daily protein target.
See your result immediately and receive a copy by email with the next steps.

landing.disclaimerNote: This is not a medical test and does not directly measure your body composition. It is a general estimate based on your answers.

quiz.selectAtLeastOne: Select every option that applies. If you have no symptoms, you can continue.

startingWeightKg.question: What did you weigh when you started treatment? (kg)

targetWeightKg.question: What weight would you like to reach? (kg)

treatmentDuration.question: How long have you been on treatment?

baselineStrengthFrequency.question: Before starting treatment, how many days a week did you do strength training?

availableDays.question: With an adapted plan, how many days a week could you do strength training?

symptoms.question: Are you currently experiencing any of these symptoms?
symptoms.hint: Select all that apply. If you have none, continue.

proteinRations.question: On a typical day, how many meals include a clear source of protein?

emailGate.title: Your estimate is ready
emailGate.body: Enter your email to see the result and receive a copy. Because your answers include health information, we need your explicit consent to process them.
emailGate.consentHealth: I consent to Muscle Keeper processing the health data I provided, including my treatment and symptoms, to calculate this estimate. I can withdraw my consent and request deletion of my data at any time.
emailGate.consentMarketing: I want to receive my result and Muscle Keeper content about strength, protein and GLP-1 treatment by email. This is optional, and I can unsubscribe at any time.
emailGate.errorConsent: We need your explicit consent to process these answers and calculate the result.
emailGate.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Try again in a few seconds.

result.title: Your personal estimate

cards.leanLossRatio: Estimated share of weight loss that may be lean mass
cards.projected6m: Estimated lean mass loss at 6 months if your current pattern continues

result.disclaimerBox: This result is a general estimate based on your answers and broad population patterns. It does not directly measure your body composition or constitute a clinical diagnosis. Discuss it with your doctor or registered dietitian before making significant changes.
result.ctaTitle: Losing weight should not mean giving up your muscle
result.ctaBody: We're building a strength and nutrition programme for people using GLP-1 treatments: realistic when you feel well and when you are dealing with low appetite, fatigue or nausea. We'll email you when it becomes available.

footer.disclaimer: Muscle Keeper provides general information and does not replace advice from your doctor, endocrinologist or registered dietitian. Do not change your medication or dose based on this app.

privacy.title: Privacy and health data
privacy.intro: Your answers about medication, symptoms, weight and habits may reveal information about your health and are considered special-category data under Article 9 of the GDPR. We process them only under the conditions explained below.

sections.title: What we store
sections.body: We store your email, quiz answers, calculated result and the technical information required to provide the service. We do not sell this data or share it with third parties for advertising purposes.

sections.title: What we use it for
sections.body: We use this data to calculate and display your result. Only when you provide separate consent will we also use your email to send Muscle Keeper content and updates. We do not use your health data for personalised advertising.

sections.title: Where your data is stored
sections.body: Data is stored using providers that apply appropriate security measures and data-protection safeguards. See this policy for the specific providers and storage locations.

sections.title: How to withdraw consent or delete your data
sections.body: You can withdraw your consent or request deletion of your personal data at any time by writing to {contactEmail}. Withdrawal does not affect processing carried out lawfully before we receive your request.
